before: पीतः क्रुद्धेन तातश्चरणतलहतो वल्लभो येन रोषा\
after: पीतः क्रुद्धेन तातश्चरणतलहतो वल्लभो येन रोषा-
why: Sragdhara (21) line is fine, but the trailing backslash is leftover markup; the edition marks the word split रोषा-द् with a hyphen as elsewhere.
Stanza is vamshastha (12 aksharas, cf. preceding pada); शिष्यशिष्य is a dittography that adds two syllables.
Vasantatilaka needs a light 7th syllable; शाशि is not a word, शशि (moon) fits metre and sense.

after: दरिद्रता धीरतया विराजते कुवस्त्रता शुभ्रतया विराजते
why: Two 12-syllable padas run together; space missing before कुवस्त्रता (cf. the next line's layout).

before: इत्थं ये पुरुषा कलासु कुशलास्तेष्वेव लोकस्थितिः ॥
after: इत्थं ये पुरुषाः कलासु कुशलास्तेष्वेव लोकस्थितिः ॥
why: Nominative plural पुरुषाः required by ये ... कुशलाः; visarga dropped.
अतिमभीरता is no word; अतिगभीरता (deep-mindedness) differs by one akshara and keeps the metre.
युगला has no case form that fits; the object of the neuter participle नालिंगितं must be युगलं (dropped anusvara), metre unchanged.
Vasantatilaka needs 14; दूरीकृताः is typed twice across the line break (18 here, and again opening 18b), so the duplicate must go.
Pairs with the fix in 18a: with the edition's hyphen convention the र् of कर्णतालैर्दूरीकृताः opens this line; text otherwise a regular vasantatilaka (14).
